On March 4, 2024, Hoshizaki Corporation acquired a 51% majority share of Öztiryakiler Madeni Eşya Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi, officially making the Turkish manufacturer a consolidated corporate subsidiary.

In May 2022, Öztiryakiler completed the construction and commenced production at a new factory facility in Çorlu, Tekirdag, expanding its infrastructure via a 93,000 square meter site according to the Investment Office of Türkiye.

Prior to acquiring the majority stake, Hoshizaki Corporation initiated its backing in November 2019 by executing an initial 28.6% equity investment through capital injection, as reported by Cooling Post.

The factory infrastructure expansion in Çorlu, completed in May 2022, involved an expenditure of approximately £6 million to erect a 22,000 square meter production facility detailed by Catering Insight.

Before the full corporate transition, the company's internal private structure was led by Yusuf Kenan Öztiryaki at 32.6%, Tahsin Öztiryaki at 32.6%, and Atakan Öztiryaki at 12.2%, as disclosed in the Hoshizaki Corporation Investment Report.
